mentions.name: Personalized RSS-to-Podcast Morning Briefing Generator
mentions.description: This tool summarizes RSS feeds, transforms the content, and transcribes it into a personalized podcast. It generates morning briefings tailored to the listener, covering weather and chance of rain, BBC/NPR top stories, specific sports news, and the most popular Hacker News posts with LLM-generated summaries of comment threads. It runs end to end on a local RTX 3070 GPU and is designed as a set-and-forget system.
mentions.problem: Staying informed meant squinting at glowing rectangles, and there is a finite amount of podcasts one can reasonably follow and digest.
mentions.audience: The builder wants a set-and-forget tool for personal daily news consumption.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a very basic prototype to summarise RSS feeds/transform the content and transcribe it in to a personalised podcast.

evidence.value: I built a very basic prototype to summarise RSS feeds/transform the content and transcribe it in to a personalised podcast.
